summary: Iter 246 - Catering Storno-Frist mit Gebühr: All features tested successfully. Backend: 10/10 tests passed for config endpoints, cancel-preview with tier calculation, and transition with fee persistence. Frontend: All UI components verified including CateringCancelConfigPanel (4 inputs + save), CateringInbox Stornieren button, CateringCancelDialog with tier badge and dynamic confirm button, and BookingsTable Catering cancel button.
seed_data_creation: Used existing catering requests for testing. One request (cat_450b03adf73b) was cancelled during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 246 fully tested. Features verified: (1) GET /api/catering-config returns defaults {24h, 50%, 4h, 100%}. (2) PUT /api/catering-config (admin only) saves and persists values. (3) GET /api/catering-requests/{id}/cancel-preview returns tier (free/late/very_late) with fee calculation based on hours_until_event vs deadline. (4) POST /api/catering-requests/{id}/transition status=cancelled persists cancellation_fee_amount, cancellation_fee_percent, cancellation_fee_tier, cancellation_hours_until_event. (5) 403 for non-owner non-staff on cancel-preview. (6) 409 for already cancelled/completed requests. (7) Frontend CateringCancelConfigPanel in Admin->Ressourcen->Catering-Artikel tab with 4 inputs (cfg-deadline-input, cfg-late-fee-input, cfg-vl-threshold-input, cfg-vl-fee-input) and cfg-save-btn. (8) CateringInbox shows red 'Stornieren' button (catering-cancel-{request_id}) on active requests. (9) CateringCancelDialog (catering-cancel-dialog) shows tier-badge (cancel-tier-badge), fee info, reason textarea (cancel-reason-input), and dynamic confirm button (cancel-dialog-confirm-btn) that shows 'Trotzdem stornieren ({amount} EUR)' for fee>0 or 'Stornieren' for free tier. (10) BookingsTable shows red 'Catering' cancel button (cancel-catering-{booking_id}) for bookings with catering_request_id.
